prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 preserves backward compatibility by detecting plain JSON Schema objects via isLikelyJsonSchema() and passing them through the deprecated overload unchanged, matching the originally documented behavior. PR #1596 takes the opposite approach — throwing an error at argument-parse time — which would be a breaking change for any existing code relying on the deprecated API with plain schemas. Since the overload is already deprecated, a graceful passthrough (1617) is safer than a hard rejection (1596).

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1617 preserves backward compatibility by detecting plain JSON Schema objects via isLikelyJsonSchema() and passing them through the deprecated overload unchanged, matching the originally documented behavior. PR #1596 takes the opposite approach — throwing an error at argument-parse time — which would be a breaking change for any existing code relying on the deprecated API with plain schemas. Since the overload is already deprecated, a graceful passthrough (1617) is safer than a hard rejection (1596).

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1679 handles a strictly wider failure surface than #1568 — it catches both EPIPE and ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED, whereas #1568 only handles EPIPE.
